_how_to_use: Questions for the Step 5 (understandQuery.js) big test. Placeholders: {competitor}, {competitor2}, {competitor_lower} = real competitors of the test client, {own} = its own company name (filled in from the database when the test runs). Fields: goals = allowed main goals (missing = any goal); companies / places = must be found; onlyPlaces / onlyCompanies = nothing else may appear; ownBusiness / ownOrDashboard = must be marked as about the client's own business or dashboard; clarify = the user must be asked back. Run: node scripts/testDynamicRag.js big5
